name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.introduce.SpeechVoiceSloganIntroduceActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects a slogan introduction. It shows the advertiser's slogan and voice-introduction material.
disableEffect: The ad's slogan introduction and any attached viewing reward will no longer be available.
